title: Layer product degree recurrence
statement: For all natural numbers $a,s,c$, the layer product with parameters $(a,s+1,c)$ equals the layer product with parameters $(a,s,c)$ multiplied by $2c-2a-2s-1$, where the layer product at $(a,k,c)$ is $\prod_{j=0}^{k-1}\bigl(2c-2(a+j)-1\bigr)$.
